_help: Game modes shown in the menu (Play). Edit, then run Sync-Modes.cmd (editor must be closed).
game: TDM | Domination | FFA (free-for-all) | TDM3 (three teams)
rules: Perspective = TP | FP | Choice (V / D-pad up switches), Loadout = Player (loadout builder) or a fixed comma list of Pistol, Rifle, Shotgun, AK47, MP5, M1911,
ScoreLimit = points (FFA: kills) to win, TimeLimit = minutes (TDM, FFA), GunGame = weapon list: each kill gives the next weapon, a kill with the last one wins
image: menu tile (1024x512 texture); empty = image of the template

modes.title: Team Deathmatch
modes.subtitle: Downtown
modes.description: Two city blocks. Streets, stoops, parked cars as cover. Switch between first and third person with V.

modes.title: Team Deathmatch (First Person)

modes.title: Sidearms Only

modes.description: Pistols only, first person, no weapon switching.

modes.title: Gun Game
modes.subtitle: Downtown
modes.description: Every kill hands you the next gun: MP5, AK-47, rifle, shotgun, M1911, pistol. First kill with the pistol wins it for your team.

modes.title: Quick Match

modes.title: Free-for-all
